sloka: अनुक्त्वा परुषं वाक्यं किञ्चिदप्यनवाक्षिपन्।अविकत्थन् वधिष्यामि त्वां पश्य पुरुषाधम ।। ६.८८.२९ ।।
transliteration: anuktvā paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ kiñcidapyanavākṣipan।avikatthan vadhiṣyāmi tvāṁ paśya puruṣādhama ।। 6.88.29 ।।

translations.english: "Lowly Rakshasa! without any harsh words, indeed without boasting, commenting, interrupting I will assail you. You may see."
